content_policy.value: Prohibits pornographic, obscene, hateful, or excessively violent content. Bans configuring AI to simulate real individuals without consent. Erotic roleplay removed February 2023, partially restored May 2023 for pre-existing users only. New users after 2023 cannot access intimacy features regardless of subscription.
content_policy.source_quote: Pornographic content is banned. Users cannot 'instructing, training, or configuring the AI to generate content depicting, describing, or simulating any identifiable real person without their consent.'

age_rating.value: 18+ on Apple App Store. Teen on Google Play (inconsistent). ToS/Privacy Policy state service not intended for under-18.
age_rating.source_quote: App Store Age Rating: 18+. Content Descriptors: Infrequent/Profanity or Crude Humor; Contains Health or Wellness Topics.
age_rating.notes: Apple App Store rating is first-party data.

data_privacy.value: Profile/conversation data retained up to 60 days after termination; financial records kept minimum 10 years. Conversation data processed transiently by third-party AI (not retained beyond response generation). Anonymized data used only internally to train safety algorithms — not shared with third-party LLMs. Conversation content not shared for marketing/advertising.
data_privacy.source_quote: The anonymized data is used only internally and is not used to train third-party large language models or other AI systems. Data shared with third-party AI providers is processed transiently and is not retained by those providers beyond the duration necessary to generate the response.
data_privacy.notes: Directly fetched from official Replika Privacy Policy.

company_info.value: Luka, Inc. (US). Co-founded by Eugenia Kuyda and Phil Dudchuk ~2012–2014 (Y Combinator). Replika launched November 2017. As of 2025, Dmytro Klochko serves as CEO.
company_info.source_quote: Company/Operator: Luka, Inc. Founding Year: ~2012 (Luka co-founded); Replika launched November 2017.

scale_metrics.value: 42M+ users worldwide (official manifesto May 2026). Milestones: 2M (Jan 2018), 10M (Jan 2023), 30M (Aug 2024), 40M+ (2025). App Store: 228K ratings, 4.4/5 stars.
scale_metrics.source_quote: Over 40 million users as of the manifesto date (May 2026).

long_term_memory.value: Yes — three-tier persistent memory (short-term, medium-term, long-term) accumulating across all sessions. Users can add info via 'Shared Notes.' Nomis remember details from months-prior conversations.
long_term_memory.source_quote: the more you talk with your Nomi, the more they'll get to know you and themselves
long_term_memory.notes: Official Nomi knowledge base confirms persistent memory. Three-tier structure confirmed by multiple review sources citing official documentation.

image_generation.value: Yes — 'Nomi Selfies' (V5 image system). Paid: up to 40 AI-generated images/day. Styles: realistic, anime, watercolor, 3D animation, and more. Custom 'anchors' maintain character consistency. No manual prompt needed for selfies (context-based).
image_generation.source_quote: the unified v5 image system can handle far more styles than realistic and anime. Think digital 3D animation, watercolor, realistic crochet world, you name it!
image_generation.notes: Confirmed via official Nomi knowledge base.

group_chat.value: Yes — up to 10 group chats, each with up to 10 Nomis (paid subscribers). Auto-play mode: Nomis message each other autonomously. Each Nomi maintains individual personality/memory and may reference group chat events in 1-on-1 later.
group_chat.source_quote: Paying users can have up to 10 group chats at a time, each with up to 10 Nomis.
group_chat.notes: Official Nomi wiki (wiki.nomi.ai). Auto-play confirmed via official X post.

character_creation.value: Yes — customize AI companions: 100s of preset appearances (realistic/anime), core personality traits, initial interests. Appearance refineable via Shared Notes + custom reference images. No public character marketplace or sharing feature — each Nomi is personal to its creator.
character_creation.source_quote: hundreds of diverse Nomi looks to choose from so you can find a Nomi you click with

creator_economy.value: No — no creator monetization or revenue-sharing program. Affiliate program referenced on homepage but details not public. No mechanism for publishing characters for sale or earning from others' interactions.
creator_economy.notes: No official source confirms a creator economy feature.

free_tier.value: Yes — limited daily messaging, 1 AI companion, small image allowance. Voice chat, group chat, unlimited messaging, full image generation (40/day) require paid subscription. Designed for trial use.
free_tier.source_quote: Basic conversational features to get a feel of Nomi's interactive personality
free_tier.notes: Exact daily message count not publicly specified by Nomi. Official pricing page returned 404.

paid_pricing.value: Launch Plan: $9.99/month or $59.99/year. Standard: $15.99/month, $39.99/quarter (~$13.33/month), or $99.99/year (~$8.33/month). Nomi Credits one-time packs: $4.99–$99.99. All paid: unlimited messages, up to 10 Nomis, 40 images/day, voice chat, group chat.
paid_pricing.source_quote: Launch Plan: $9.99/month or $59.99/year; Standard Plan: $15.99/month, $39.99/quarter, or $99.99/year; Nomi Credits: $4.99–$99.99
paid_pricing.notes: Pricing from Apple App Store listing (current in-app purchase prices).

supported_languages.value: English-only interface. AI can converse in multiple languages (English, Turkish, German, others reported by users). No official list published.
supported_languages.notes: Interface English-only confirmed by multiple user reports and reviews. AI multilingual capability is user-reported, not officially quantified.

platforms.source_quote: Nomi: AI Companion with a Soul
platforms.notes: iOS App Store confirmed. Android (package: ai.nomi.twa) confirmed via Similarweb. Web access at beta.nomi.ai confirmed via official homepage.

content_policy.value: 18+ required. Mature themes and NSFW roleplay in text permitted for verified adult users. Explicit or nude image generation not allowed (credit card processor and app store restrictions). Prohibited: illegal material, harassment, impersonation, minor content.
content_policy.source_quote: If you are under the age of 18, you cannot use the Nomi.ai platform under any circumstances
content_policy.notes: ToS confirmed via search result excerpt. Explicit image prohibition confirmed by multiple sources citing official policy.

age_rating.value: 18+ on Apple App Store. Content descriptors: sexual content or nudity, mature/suggestive themes, profanity, substance references. ToS minimum age: 18.
age_rating.source_quote: Age Rating: 18+; Content Descriptors: Sexual content or nudity, Mature or suggestive themes, Profanity or crude humor
age_rating.notes: Sourced directly from Apple App Store listing (app ID 6450270929, developer: AI GLIMPSE INC.).

data_privacy.value: Conversations may be stored in training archives and used to improve AI model. Upon account deletion, personal info removed within ~28 days. Does not sell/rent user data. Individual message deletion not available. After deletion, training archive data no longer attributable to user.
data_privacy.source_quote: We do not and will not sell or rent to any third party any of your personal information. [...] information that is in our training or communications archives [...] any information in our training archives would no longer be attributable to you.
data_privacy.notes: Official privacy policy at nomi.ai/privacy-policy/ successfully fetched.

company_info.value: Glimpse.ai, Inc. (also AI Glimpse Inc.), Maryland corporation. Founded by Alex Cardinell (CEO). Launched 2023. Bootstrapped (no VC), based in Baltimore MD. Team ~8 people.
company_info.notes: Legal entity from ToS. CEO and bootstrapped/team-size from TechCrunch (April 2024).

scale_metrics.value: Tens of millions of Nomis created per CEO (Jan 2026 stream). 'Hundreds of thousands of active Nomi users' per official partnership page. ~1.25M monthly website visits (Semrush early 2026), avg session 12 min. Ranked #7 in Character Chat Tools globally (March 2026).
scale_metrics.source_quote: The last time I checked - which was a long time ago - I think we were already in the tens of millions. And that was ages ago, so the real number now is far higher.
scale_metrics.notes: CEO statement from official Nomi wiki stream summary. Website traffic from Semrush (third-party).

long_term_memory.value: Yes — multi-tier architecture: short-term context (18K chars Standard / 50K Ultra / 125K MAX), cascaded memory context (480K Standard / 1.2M Ultra), key memories/journal entries persistent indefinitely. Higher tiers recall more memories/turn (3 Standard, 5 Ultra).
long_term_memory.source_quote: your Kindroid has long term memory recall over everything you talk about
long_term_memory.notes: Confirmed from official Kindroid Help Center FAQ and billing/subscription documentation.

image_generation.value: Yes — 'selfies' via Tableau diffusion engine. Free: 1 credit/2h. Standard paid: 1 credit/30min. Ultra/MAX: 2 credits/30min. Auto-selfies (paid only): AI generates images automatically from conversation context. Video selfies also available (paid tiers).
image_generation.source_quote: Auto-selfies lets Kindroids generate prompts based on conversation context
image_generation.notes: Confirmed from official Kindroid Help Center selfies documentation.

group_chat.value: Yes — up to 10 AI characters simultaneously (paid Standard+ only). Turn-taking: auto or manual (@Name mentions). Group selfies and group video calls supported. Shared memory toggle for bidirectional context sharing.
group_chat.source_quote: a maximum of 10 Kindroids per Groupchat
group_chat.notes: Confirmed from official Kindroid Help Center groupchats documentation.

character_creation.value: Yes — fully customizable: name, backstory (primary personality source), response directive, key memories, example messages, journal entries, user personas, model flairs (Companion/Roleplay/Narrative/Minimal), conversation dynamism, avatar (custom upload or AI-generated), voice. Free: up to 2 Kindroids. Standard paid: unlimited.
character_creation.source_quote: Backstory is the primary personality source where users describe the character's speech, mood, behavior, and uniqueness.
character_creation.notes: Confirmed from official Kindroid Help Center.

creator_economy.value: No — Kindroid Social allows sharing character profiles publicly, but no payment system, revenue sharing, or creator earnings program in any official documentation.
creator_economy.source_quote: The documentation contains no information about payment systems, revenue sharing, or monetization opportunities for creators.
creator_economy.notes: Confirmed absence from official documentation and FAQs.

free_tier.value: Yes — 2 AI companions, unlimited text messages (slower during high traffic), 1 selfie credit/2h, basic long-term memory recall, 3-day full-feature premium trial (no credit card required). Group chat, voice calls, auto-selfies, video selfies not included.
free_tier.source_quote: Two AI companions, unlimited messages with basic memory, one selfie request every two hours, 3-day premium trial (no credit card required)
free_tier.notes: Third-party review corroborated by official FAQ.

paid_pricing.value: Standard: $13.99/month (web), $15.99/month (app stores), $139.99/year ($11.66/month). Ultra add-on: $24.99/month (requires Standard). MAX add-on: $59.99/month (requires Ultra). 3-month Standard: $37.99 web / $42.99 app stores. Optional extras: 4 extra companion slots $3.49 each; 50 selfie credits $6.99; 500K audio credits $14.99.
paid_pricing.notes: App Store in-app purchase prices from Apple App Store. Web prices from reputable review sources cross-referencing official site.

supported_languages.value: 28 languages for voice calls/messaging. Class 1 (10, full mixing): English, Spanish, French, German, Hindi, Russian, Portuguese, Japanese, Italian, Dutch. Class 2 (6): Ukrainian, Swedish, Chinese, Turkish, Indonesian, Korean. Plus 12 additional (Polish, Bulgarian, Romanian, Czech, Greek, Finnish, Malay, Slovak, Danish, Norwegian, Hungarian, Vietnamese). Interface: English only.
supported_languages.source_quote: Class 1 Languages (C1) - 10 languages: English, Spanish, French, German, Hindi, Russian, Portuguese, Japanese, Italian, Dutch. Class 2 Languages (C2) - 6 languages: Ukrainian, Swedish, Chinese, Turkish, Indonesian, Korean.
supported_languages.notes: Confirmed from official Kindroid Help Center voice calls documentation.

platforms.value: iOS (requires iOS 15+; also Mac with Apple M1, Apple Vision), Android, and web (browser-based). All platforms sync conversation history and memory.
platforms.source_quote: iPhone (iOS 15.0 or later), iPod touch (iOS 15.0 or later), Mac (macOS 12.0 or later with Apple M1 chip or later), Apple Vision (visionOS 1.0 or later)
platforms.notes: iOS confirmed from App Store. Android from Google Play. Web from multiple sources.

content_policy.value: Permits NSFW/erotic roleplay, fictional violence, sensitive topics. Three absolute prohibitions: (1) imminent self-harm planning with specific method/timeline, (2) imminent real-world harm to others, (3) sexual/abusive content involving minors (zero tolerance, under-18 regardless of jurisdiction). Philosophy: 'freedom with responsibility.'
content_policy.source_quote: Explicitly Allowed Content: 'NSFW (Not Safe for Work) and Erotic Roleplay', 'Fictional Violence, Horror, and other creative storytelling'
content_policy.notes: Confirmed from official Kindroid moderation guidelines.

age_rating.value: 18+ on iOS App Store. ToS: 'Services are only for use by individuals who are at least 18 years of age or the age of majority in their jurisdiction.' Platform may request proof of age; failure to provide results in account suspension.
age_rating.notes: Age rating confirmed from Apple App Store listing.

data_privacy.value: Chat conversations encrypted at rest and in transit; Kindroid staff cannot access them during normal operations. Data not sold to third parties. Conversations retained until user deletes specific AI or account. Decryption only with user consent during Trust & Safety appeals. Privacy policy does not explicitly state whether conversations are used for model training.
data_privacy.source_quote: Chat conversations are encrypted at rest and in transit, limiting Kindroid's operational visibility. Decryption may occur for legal compliance.
data_privacy.notes: Confirmed from official Kindroid legal/privacy policy.

company_info.value: Kindroid, Inc. Founded 2023 by Jerry Meng, headquartered Los Angeles CA (5551 Hollywood Blvd #1277, 90028). Raised $1M Pre-Seed (Pear VC). ~7 employees as of early 2026.
company_info.source_quote: Founded in 2023 by Jerry Meng in Los Angeles. Kindroid has raised a total of $1M in funding. Investors: Pear VC.
company_info.notes: Sourced from StartupHub.ai, corroborated by Tracxn and CBInsights. Address confirmed from official legal page.

scale_metrics.value: 1.2M+ Android downloads, ~64K new downloads/month (early 2026). Google Play: 4.46/5 from 20K+ reviews. iOS App Store: 4.8 stars. No official MAU count publicly disclosed.
scale_metrics.source_quote: The service has accumulated over 1.2 million Android downloads with approximately 64,000 new downloads monthly.
scale_metrics.notes: Download and rating figures from StartupHub.ai and WeavAI review blog. Third-party estimates; no first-party metrics publicly disclosed.

long_term_memory.value: No automatic persistent cross-session memory. Within-session: ~9K token context (free) or ~45K (janitor+). Users can manually summarize. 'Scripts' (Knowledge/Lore) allow permanent character context injection. Cross-session memory announced as upcoming ('Buckets/Books/Letters' via vector embedding).
long_term_memory.notes: Official March 2025 announcement lists cross-session memory as upcoming feature, not yet shipped.

image_generation.value: No native built-in image generation. Users can embed externally hosted images via markdown (HTTPS URLs). No official announcement of a native feature as of June 2026.
image_generation.source_quote: Image Generation: Not available. The platform is 'only focused on text-based chatbot interaction' with no multimedia capabilities.
image_generation.notes: Confirmed by independent review dated April 17, 2026.

group_chat.value: No native group chat (multiple AI characters simultaneously). Multi-persona feature allows switching between user personas mid-conversation. 'Public chats' (March 31 2026) lets users share/fork conversations — not multi-AI group chat.
group_chat.source_quote: Users can switch between different personas mid-conversation using a persona switcher near the chat input.
group_chat.notes: Official March 31, 2026 announcement describes multi-persona (user side only).

character_creation.value: Yes — any registered user can create/publish characters. Fields: bot image, name, personality, initial message, chat name, bio, scenario, up to 10 tags. Private or shared to community library. Thousands of community-created characters hosted.
character_creation.source_quote: Bot Image: the image shown on the bot card on your profile; Character Name: appears on the bot card; Personality: where you will write the majority of the bot's information that will be used during chats; Initial Message: the introduction message users see when opening a chat.

creator_economy.value: No — no creator revenue-sharing or monetization program. Analytics dashboards launched January 13 2026 (impressions, clicks, views, engagement, retention) but no financial compensation. Roadmap mentioned optional premium features but no revenue-share model.
creator_economy.source_quote: Nine core metrics tracking discovery and engagement: Impressions, clicks, and views measure visibility.
creator_economy.notes: Analytics dashboard confirmed from official January 13, 2026 announcement. No revenue-share program found in any official source.

free_tier.value: Yes (permanently free option guaranteed) — access to JanitorLLM model, unlimited chats with community characters, character creation, ~9K token context. Users can also connect own external API keys (OpenAI, Claude, KoboldAI, DeepSeek) at own cost.
free_tier.source_quote: Unlimited chats with millions of bots; Access to standard chat models; Context limit of around 9k tokens. We will always keep a free option available for everyone.
free_tier.notes: Official FAQ on subscriptions from help.janitorai.com.

paid_pricing.value: janitor+ launched June 24 2026 at $12.99/month. Includes 5× greater context window (~45K tokens), unlimited priority messaging, monthly advanced model swipes allowance, golden username badge. Platform was entirely free before this launch.
paid_pricing.source_quote: The subscription costs $12.99/month and launched on June 24, 2026, accessible at janitorai.com/plus.
paid_pricing.notes: Directly from official janitor+ launch announcement.

supported_languages.value: Multi-language UI support added June 22 2026. Specific list of all supported languages not published in announcement. Underlying AI models can respond in many languages depending on model used.
supported_languages.source_quote: The janitor interface is now translated into a bunch of new languages.
supported_languages.notes: Official June 22, 2026 announcement confirms multi-language UI but does not list specific languages.

platforms.value: Web (janitorai.com), iOS (App Store, ID 6692609366), Android (Google Play, com.janitor.ai). Mobile app launched public beta February 7 2026. NSFW disabled by default on mobile apps due to app store policies; must be enabled via website settings.
platforms.source_quote: iOS App ID: 6692609366; Android Package: com.janitor.ai; Developer: Janitor AI Inc.

content_policy.value: NSFW permitted for 18+ users. 'Limited' (SFW) and 'Limitless' modes. Strictly prohibited: sexual/romantic content involving minors, bestiality, harassment, hate speech, discrimination, content involving real-world public figures, platform integrity violations. NSFW disabled by default on mobile apps.
content_policy.source_quote: Sexual or romantic content involving minors is strictly prohibited, including any sexual or romantic portrayal of characters who are clearly or likely under the age of 18.
content_policy.notes: janitorai.com/content returned 403; content policy details from search result summaries citing official guidelines.

age_rating.value: iOS App Store: 17+. Google Play: 'High Maturity'. ToS minimum age: 18. Age verification implemented for Brazil, Australia, UK users as of June 15 2026 (regional regulations).
age_rating.source_quote: The app is rated 16+ due to mature themes. Due to App Store guidelines, NSFW content is disabled by default.
age_rating.notes: App Store rating confirmed via search result. ToS minimum age from multiple sources.

data_privacy.value: Operated by JanitorAI Inc. (US). Payment also via Dulova Investments Limited (Nicosia, Cyprus, HE 477877). Data processed/stored in US and other countries. Retained only as long as necessary. Chat content not shared with third parties per policy. GDPR rights: access, rectify, erase, restrict, port (privacy@janitorai.com).
data_privacy.source_quote: JanitorAI Inc. operates the JanitorAI platform. Payment processing services for the Platform are provided by JanitorAI Inc. and its affiliates, including Dulova Investments Limited located at 10-12 Florinis Street, 1065, Nicosia, Cyprus, Company Registration Number HE 477877.
data_privacy.notes: janitorai.com/policy/ returned 403; details from search result summaries quoting official policy text.

company_info.value: JanitorAI Inc. (US). Founded by Jan Zoltkowski (Australian software developer). Launched June 2023 (1M+ users in first week). Cyprus affiliate Dulova Investments Limited (HE 477877) handles payment processing. As of 2026 team includes staff member 'Shep.'
company_info.source_quote: shep here — the platform exists as an alternative to 'other sites strict filters'; the team is expanding.
company_info.notes: Founder name Jan Zoltkowski confirmed by HackerNoon and Science Times. Corporate entity from ToS summaries.

scale_metrics.value: 164.44M monthly visits (Semrush, May 2026), global rank #202, US rank #135, avg session 17min 39sec. #11 all AI tools globally, #2 Character Chat Tools category (43.09% market share) as of April 2026. 1.4M+ DAU, billions of weekly interactions. 1M+ users in first week of launch (June 2023).
scale_metrics.source_quote: In May 2026, janitorai.com received 164.44 million visits, representing a 16.43% increase from April. The site ranks #202 globally and #135 in the United States.
scale_metrics.notes: Traffic from Semrush (May 2026). DAU from official announcement page. Category rank from aitools.xyz (April 2026).

long_term_memory.value: Yes (manual/user-curated) — Lorebook: keyword-triggered context injection per story. Memory field: persistent text always in context window per story. Not automatic AI-driven extraction; user manages entries. Subscription tier determines context window size (3,072–28,672 tokens).
long_term_memory.source_quote: The Lorebook functions through entries — each containing activation keys that trigger contextual insertion. When you mention a key word or phrase in your story, 'the entry's text gets inserted into the context.'
long_term_memory.notes: Lorebook persists as part of saved stories.

image_generation.value: Yes — NovelAI Diffusion (currently V4.5), anime-style. Includes text-to-image, image-to-image, inpainting, post-processing. Uses 'Anlas' currency. Opus subscribers get free generations under certain conditions (normal size, single gen, ≤28 steps).
image_generation.source_quote: Purpose-built Creative Editor centered on simplifying the generation process. Image2Image functionality to modify details while preserving composition. Inpainting: Brush-based editing to fix errors or add new elements.
image_generation.notes: Image generation is a distinct module from chat — not embedded within a chat conversation.

group_chat.value: No — structured one-on-one story-writing: user controls one character, AI controls one character in alternating turns. No simultaneous multi-AI-character chat.
group_chat.source_quote: The AI maintain a 'chat style' narrative between two characters, while keeping the role of one of the characters strictly under your control.
group_chat.notes: No group chat feature found on official website or documentation.

character_creation.value: Yes — characters defined via Memory section, Lorebook entries, and image generation prompt system. Custom AI modules trainable on user-provided data (Opus tier). No standalone shareable 'character card' system comparable to Character.AI.
character_creation.source_quote: Users can access 'Memory, Author's Note, Lorebook Entries and custom AI Modules' when exporting stories.
character_creation.notes: Character creation is a core part of the storytelling workflow.

creator_economy.value: No — subscription-only model (Tablet/Scroll/Opus). No marketplace for selling characters/stories/modules, no affiliate program, no revenue sharing for creators.
creator_economy.source_quote: Join thousands of AI artists that use NovelAI every single day.
creator_economy.notes: Absence confirmed by G2 user review and absence from all official pages.

free_tier.value: Trial only (Paper Tier) — 30 free image generations (up to 1024×1024), 50 free text generations, 100 free TTS generations. No ongoing free tier — paid subscription required after trial limits exhausted.
free_tier.source_quote: 30 free image generations (up to 1024x1024). '50 free Text generations' for verified accounts. 100 free text-to-speech generations.
free_tier.notes: Free trial is one-time only, tied to email verification.

paid_pricing.value: Tablet: $10/month (unlimited text+TTS, 1,000 Anlas/month). Scroll: $15/month (all Tablet + larger context, 1,000 Anlas/month). Opus: $25/month (28,672 token context, exclusive models incl. Xialong, free image gen under certain limits, 10,000 Anlas/month). All billed monthly in USD.
paid_pricing.source_quote: Tablet Tier: $10 USD monthly. Scroll Tier: $15 USD monthly. Opus Tier: $25 USD monthly — 10,000 Anlas refill every month.
paid_pricing.notes: Anlas is NovelAI's in-platform currency for image generation.

supported_languages.value: UI: English and Japanese only. A dedicated Japanese-language AI model (Genji) exists alongside English models. Content generation may work in other languages depending on the underlying model.
supported_languages.source_quote: NovelAI supports both English and Japanese languages for its UI.
supported_languages.notes: UI language change accessible through Goose Menu.

platforms.value: Web only (novelai.net) with PWA support (installable on iOS/Android via 'Add to Home Screen'). No official native app on App Store or Google Play by Anlatan.
platforms.source_quote: You can already access NovelAI through your mobile web browser. The NovelAI website is also available as a Progressive Web Application.
platforms.notes: Third-party apps using 'NovelAI' name appear on App Store but are not published by Anlatan.

content_policy.value: 18+ required. Permissive NSFW — adding 'NSFW' tag removes default content filter. All generated content belongs to the user; Anlatan does not claim ownership. Specific prohibited categories (e.g., CSAM) not detailed in publicly accessible terms.
content_policy.source_quote: You must be 18 years or older and be capable of entering a legal contract in the United States.
content_policy.notes: Wikipedia notes controversy around generating lolicon/shotacon imagery without restrictions.

age_rating.value: ToS minimum: 18 years. No official App Store age rating by Anlatan (web-only service). Third-party apps using 'NovelAI' branding carry different ratings unrelated to Anlatan.
age_rating.source_quote: You must be 18 years or older and be capable of entering a legal contract in the United States.
age_rating.notes: Anlatan has not published an official iOS or Android app.

data_privacy.value: User requests, uploads, edits, and generations not logged or stored (session-only, deleted on page refresh unless downloaded). Stories stored encrypted with AES-256 E2E encryption — even Anlatan admins cannot read content. Voluntarily provided training data cannot be deleted after training starts. GDPR users may request account deletion (irreversible). Content export allowed within 45 days of subscription end.
data_privacy.source_quote: Any information voluntarily provided for AI model training cannot be deleted after training has started. Users cannot exercise deletion rights on data produced by the AI system.
data_privacy.notes: 'No logging of generations' policy prominently marketed by Anlatan.

company_info.value: Operated by Anlatan, Inc., incorporated in Wilmington Delaware USA. First launched beta June 15 2021 (Calliope/GPT-Neo-2.7B). Image generation added October 3 2022. Cloud-based SaaS subscription service.
company_info.source_quote: Grew 'from 0 to 40K users in 3 months' following CoreWeave partnership in 2021. Launch Date: April 28, 2021 (official); June 15, 2021 (beta).
company_info.notes: Wikipedia used as source (official About page returned 404). Copyright notice on novelai.net shows 'Copyright 2026 Anlatan Inc.'.

scale_metrics.value: 0 to 40K users in 3 months post-launch (2021). ~8.11M monthly website visits (SimilarWeb, November 2025), avg session 15min 19sec. r/NovelAi subreddit: ~41K subscribers. 'Thousands of AI artists every day' (official, unspecific).
scale_metrics.source_quote: Join thousands of AI artists that use NovelAI every single day.
scale_metrics.notes: 8.11M visits from SimilarWeb (November 2025) via secondary sources. 40K users metric from Wikipedia citing 2021 CoreWeave partnership. No official current subscriber count disclosed.
